hearth.standing.gossip.arrived.good: Word of your deeds has reached %1$s (from %2$s). They think the better of you for it.
hearth.standing.gossip.arrived.bad: Word of your deeds has reached %1$s (from %2$s). They think the worse of you for it.
hearth.standing.dialogue.reputation: What do folk here say about me?
hearth.standing.dialogue.news: Any news from the other towns?
hearth.standing.dialogue.amends_bribe: Let me make it up to you (%s).
hearth.standing.dialogue.ask.persuade: Come now, I only want to know.
hearth.standing.dialogue.ask.intimidate: Tell me, or you'll regret it.
hearth.standing.say.flatter.success.0: Oh, go on with you. But thank you.
hearth.standing.say.flatter.success.1: Kind of you to say. Not many notice.
hearth.standing.say.flatter.success.2: Well! You have a silver tongue, stranger.
hearth.standing.say.flatter.failure.0: Save your sweet talk for someone who wants it.
hearth.standing.say.flatter.failure.2: Flattery won't get you anywhere with me.
hearth.standing.say.refuse.0: I've nothing to say to the likes of you.
hearth.standing.say.refuse.2: Why would I tell you anything?
hearth.standing.say.ask.persuade.failure: I said no, and I meant it.
hearth.standing.say.ask.intimidate.failu: Threaten me again and I'll call the guard.
Is that meant to scare me? Get out of my sight.
hearth.standing.say.bribe.refused.0: Keep your coin. I'm not for sale.
hearth.standing.say.bribe.refused.1: Put that away before someone sees.
hearth.standing.say.bribe.refused.2: You think you can buy me? Shame on you.
hearth.standing.say.cannot_afford.0: You haven't the coin for that.
hearth.standing.say.cannot_afford.1: Come back when your purse is heavier.
hearth.standing.say.cannot_afford.2: That's not enough, and you know it.
hearth.standing.say.amends.success.0: Well. Perhaps I was hasty. We'll see.
hearth.standing.say.amends.success.1: I'll think on it. That's more than you'd have had yesterday.
hearth.standing.say.amends.success.2: Words are cheap, but I'll take them. For now.
hearth.standing.say.amends.failure.0: Words won't mend what you did.
hearth.standing.say.amends.failure.1: I don't believe a word of it.
hearth.standing.say.amends.bribed.1: Coin speaks louder than apologies. Very well.
hearth.standing.say.amends.bribed.2: I'll not say no to that. Let's call it even.
hearth.standing.say.no_news: Nothing much. The roads have been quiet.
hearth.standing.page.title: Reputation of %s
hearth.standing.page.none: No town has dealings with you yet.
hearth.standing.page.heading: Reputation
hearth.standing.page.no_company: No company. Form one with /hearth company form <name>.
hearth.standing.page.empty: You have no standing anywhere yet. Every town starts as a stranger's.
hearth.standing.command.not_running: The standing module is not running.
hearth.standing.command.deed: Deed %1$s (%2$s) in %3$s: standing %4$s → %5$s, %6$s news on the road.
hearth.standing.command.gossip: News on the road: %1$s (held for unsettled towns: %2$s), today is day %3$s.
hearth.standing.company.disbanded: You were the last of %s; the company is disbanded.
hearth.standing.company.invited: You have invited %s to your company.
hearth.standing.company.disabled: Companies are not allowed on this server.
hearth.standing.company.bad_name: A company's name is 2 to 32 letters, digits, spaces, apostrophes or hyphens.
hearth.standing.company.name_taken: There is already a company called %s.
hearth.standing.company.already_member: You already belong to a company. Leave it first.
hearth.standing.company.not_member: You do not belong to a company.
hearth.standing.company.not_invited: You need an invitation from a member of %s.
hearth.standing.company.invitation: %1$s invites you to join the company %2$s. Type /hearth company join %3$s to swear in.
hearth.standing.company.info: %1$s: %2$s. Members share %3$s%% of each other's standing.
